test_title: PYST 1: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 24 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate option:
This mountain is ___ than the one we climbed last year.
solution:
The correct answer is '**higher**'.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence compares two mountains, indicating a comparison of height. Hence, the comparative form of the adjective "high" is required.
 
• The correct comparative form of "high" is "**higher**."
